book.name: 1 Tasoloni
book.title: Lepran Ɗenshee Ɗǝ Pool Ran Nenyil Tasolonǝ mo

content: Wu Ɗak Suk Mbǝ Ji nDaa Jesu
Ɗyemnaa mo, baa nii mee kwoop nǝ, kǝ mu ran mee mbii nwun nkaa parpuus kǝ peeɗi Daa Jesu wur njì kas.
Wuu ten wu man pwoo nkaa nǝ. Wun shikáa fuu, wuu ten wu man nee, parpuus mǝnǝ ɓe Daa wur njì a kaa wat ɗe kǝ jì mpar sǝ.

Nciit kǝ mǝnǝ, ɓe gurum mon mɓwet sut, ɗang mon nsat nǝnee, << <<Koo meyii, ɓe nǝ ɗe ryang, kǝ mbii mo ɗi rǝre.>> Ɗangɓe, ndi mman, mee jeel kǝ shwal ntaa nkaa mo, kaa shwal ɗe mat moo kǝlǝng nǝ, kaaɗe mo pǝ làa-làa sǝ. Parmǝnǝ ɓe baa mee gwar mbar kas koo mǝndong.
Amma wun ɗyemnaa fen mo, baa wun a nɗǝǝn peenkoo kas. Mbǝmǝnǝ taji parpuus mǝnǝ ɗee nwun a mbii aapwoo, kaaɗe jì kǝ wat aapwoo ngurum mo sǝ kas.
Wun jir, wun a nen ɗe mo nɗǝǝn peeɓang, ɗe wuu mwaan mpuus, baa wun a nen ɗe nɗǝǝn peenkwoo mo kas, ɗe muu tong nɗǝǝn peenkwoo sǝ kas.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, taji wu saam kaaɗe koor gurum moo cìn sǝ kas, amma mu yaasun, kǝ mǝ tong ɗi shi gongpee.
Gurum moo saam a mpar, kǝ gurum moo yuur a mpar,

amma mun, muu mwaan a mpuus. Mbǝmǝnǝ ɓe mǝ yaasun fun mo. Mu sat a nsekyeen nɗǝǝn shinzeen, kǝ wal nɗǝǝn Daa Jesu. Mbǝɗe ɗesǝ mo a kaa nlǝr shool, ɗe shiitoon moo lep mɓe gong tuur mmo, mbǝkǝ taji mee mbii tung mo kas sǝ. Kǝzak, wu yit kǝ mu sat a nleyit nkaa Daa Jesu ɗǝ wur ɓam mun. Mbǝɗe leyit ɗesǝ nǝ ɗee a kaa mbiikáa shool ɗe kǝ fwang káa ngurum nɗǝǝn lek sǝ.
Mu man nǝ, Naan wu bǝlǝp mun, baa a mbǝkǝ mǝ ɗel ɗe nɗǝǝn jeel kǝ tuup nwur kas, ɗangɓe wur bǝlǝp mun a mbǝkǝ mu kat ɓam ɗe nɗǝǝn Daa Jesu Kristi.
Wur ɗewur muut, mbǝkǝ katɗang wur mbaajì, ɓe koo ɗe mu kuɗi mmeen nɗǝǝn yil nǝ, kǝ koo ɗe muu ten mu murǝp, ɓe mun ntong ashak kǝ nwur.
Mbǝmǝnǝ wu gangkwak nshak, kǝ wu ɓamshak kaaɗe wuu pǝ ncìn nǝ sǝ.
Kyes mPwoo Nǝ Mo
Ɗyemnaa mo, mu ɗang pǝ wun kǝ wu shìn ɗeɗes nen ɗe moo cìn ɗak pee wun ɗi. Muu sat a nen ɗe moo fwang wun kǝ kam wun nɗǝǝn kǝǝr nDaa.
Wu shìn ɗeɗes mmo hakyeng, kǝ wu wal mmo zak, mbǝ ɗak ɗe moo cìn nǝ. Wu tongryang kǝ shak jir.
Ɗyemnaa mo, muu ɗang pǝ wun, mbǝkǝ wu gwak nenseer mo, ɗe sar fur mon nfii. Wuu gang pǝtuup nen ɗe moo kǝǝrmuut mo, kǝ wu ɓam nen ɗe baa moo ɓal kas, kǝ wu gung kǝ shak jir zak.
Wu tap, mbǝkǝ taji mee gwar kwat ɗebish shi ɗebish kas, amma wu gung kǝ wu cìn ɗeret ɗe nshak kǝ gurum mo jir, koo pǝrangyi.
Wu cìn retnyit koo pǝrangyi.
Wu ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) shidaar-shidaar.
nƊǝǝn mbii mo jir, ɓe wu pǝlang Naan, mbǝɗe nii ret nNaan mbǝ wun nen ɗe mo kǝ ɓal wun kǝ Jesu Kristi, kǝ wun cìn zak.
Taji wu cíi cìn ɗak nRiin Naan ɗe wu nɗǝǝn wun kas.
Taji wu ɓákpwoo ɗe mo put a pǝ Naan ɗi kas.
Wu kam mbii mo jir, mbǝkǝ wu man ɗi nǝ azeen ɗe. Wu yaa mbii ɗe mo a ɗeret.
Taji wu cìn mee mbii ɗebish kas koo le.

Wen cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) nǝ, Naan shikáa fin, wur ɗewur cìn tongryang nwun, wu nle kǝ wu ɗee a ɗeɓang nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir. nƊǝǝn riin fuu mo, kǝ seen fuu mo, kǝ suk fuu mo, mbǝkǝ wu ɗak suk fuu mo ɗe, mɓe puus jì Daa Jesu Kristi, ɓe baa wun nɗen kǝ mee yitluwaan (naasheep) kas.
Naan ɗewur pǝrep wun agu cinzeen baa wur mmak ɓam wun kas.
Ɗyemnaa mo, wu cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) mɓe mun.
Wu tok kǝ nen cínzeen nǝ mo jir shi tokshik ɗǝɓang, wu yaa sar nshak nɗǝǝn wal ɗe nǝ a mǝ Naan.
nƊǝǝn sǝm kǝ Daa, ɓe an kǝn satpwoo nwun shiɓal nee, nǝ a tǝng wu tang lepran ɗesǝ nǝ nkom nen cínzeen nǝ mo jir.
Ɗeret Daa fun Jesu Kristi nǝ tong ashak kǝ wun. Nǝ aasǝ.
